description: This file defines the 'ProjectRepository' interface, which declares methods for finding, saving, and removing 'Project' entities within the domain layer of the application.

classes.name: ProjectRepository
classes.description: Interface for project-related persistence operations, including retrieval, saving, and deletion of Project entities.

methods.name: findProject
methods.description: Retrieves a Project entity by its project ID.

methods.name: saveProject
methods.description: Persists or updates a Project entity.

methods.name: removeProject
methods.description: Removes a Project entity identified by its project ID.
